scheduled_maintenances.name: Sendgrid Maintenance Impacting Delivery and Account Configuration

incident_updates.body:
This maintenance has been rescheduled. We are upgrading our infrastructure on October 28 2026, from 21:00 to 22:30 PDT to enhance system stability and scalability.

During this window customers may experience delays impacting the following functionalities:
- Email delivery for new sign-ups and upgraded accounts
- Account configuration and settings updates
- Processing of group unsubscribes
- Dedicated IP and IP pool changes

System functionality will resume normally once maintenance concludes. Thank you for your patience.
